name: inspect-byte-budget
title: dsh-find-ideas: cut inspect_projects return bytes by 69% (two-stage funnel)
description: Measured: inspect_projects returns 49.4KB per call and accounts for 593.0K of 825.8K total tool-result bytes (71.8%) in the A/B eval. That single block is why arm B costs 15.25% more billed input than arm A despite making 35% fewer tool calls. This task removes the redundancy (M1, -48%) and adds a second-stage point-read tool (M2, -69% cumulative), targeting 181.1K total / 15.1K per call. Outcome: the byte targets were reached in part (-56.1% of the 593.0K baseline, not -69%), the byte budget knob was withdrawn in favour of a fixed cap, and the A/B re-run showed the card bytes were never the binding constraint on billed tokens. See prd.md's Acceptance Criteria for the per-criterion measurement.
